In addition to the [[2025–26 Bundesliga|domestic league]], the club participated in this season's editions of the [[2025–26 DFB-Pokal|DFB-Pokal]], the [[2025 Franz Beckenbauer Supercup|Franz Beckenbauer Supercup]], and the [[2025–26 UEFA Champions League|UEFA Champions League]]. The season was the first since [[2007–08 FC Bayern Munich season|2007–08]] without club legend and record appearance holder [[Thomas Müller]], who had won 34 major trophies throughout his career, making him the most decorated German footballer of all time.{{cite news |title=Thomas Müller's greatest records at Bayern |url=https://fcbayern.com/en/news/2025/05/thomas-muller-s-greatest-records-at-bayern |publisher=FC Bayern Munich |access-date=18 June 2025 |date=10 May 2025}} The season was also the first since [[2014–15 FC Bayern Munich season|2014–15]] without [[Kingsley Coman]], as he joined [[Saudi Pro League|Saudi]] club [[Al Nassr FC|Al-Nassr]], as well as the first since [[2019–20 FC Bayern Munich season|2019–20]] without [[Leroy Sané]], as he joined [[Süper Lig|Turkish]] champions [[Galatasaray S.K. (football)|Galatasaray]] when his contract expired.{{cite news |date=29 June 2025 |title=Kingsley Coman joins Al Nassr from Bayern Munich |url=https://www.spl.com.sa/en/news/756425/www.spl.com.sa/en/news/756425/kingsley-coman-joins-al-nassr-from-bayern-munich |access-date=17 August 2025 |publisher=Saudi Professional League Association}}{{cite web |title=Leroy Aziz Sané'nin transferi konusunda görüşmelere başlandı |url=https://www.galatasaray.org/haber/gs-sportif-a-s/leroy-aziz-sane-nin-transferi-konusunda-gorusmelere-baslandi/57938 |publisher=Galatasaray S.K. |access-date=11 June 2025 |language=tr}} On 29 October 2025, Bayern broke [[AC Milan]]'s record in [[1992–93 AC Milan season|1992–93]] of winning the first 13 matches of the season for the best start in Europe's top five leagues, after surpassing their own [[2012–13 FC Bayern Munich season|2012–13]] record of 12 matches by beating [[1. FC Köln]] with a score line of 1–4.{{cite news |url=https://www.bundesliga.com/en/bundesliga/news/cologne-bayern-munich-live-dfb-cup-preview-report-kane-kompany-34509 |title=Bayern Munich break European record in DFB Cup win over Cologne |publisher=Bundesliga |date=29 October 2025 }} They further extended the record to 16 consecutive victories by 4 November by beating [[Paris Saint-Germain FC|Paris Saint-Germain]] 1–2.{{cite news |url=https://www.bundesliga.com/en/bundesliga/news/bayern-munich-numbers-behind-record-winning-streak-kane-kompany-34665 |title=The numbers behind Bayern Munich's record 16-game winning streak |publisher=Bundesliga |date=8 November 2025 }} On 11 April 2026, Bayern recorded a 5–0 away victory against [[FC St. Pauli]] on matchday 29, bringing their season tally to 105 goals and surpassing their previous record of 101 goals set in the [[1971–72 Bundesliga|1971–72 season]].{{cite news |url=https://www.bundesliga.com/en/bundesliga/news/bayern-munich-set-new-goalscoring-record-105-goal-leon-goretzka-harry-kane-michael-olise-36723 |title=Bayern Munich set new all-time Bundesliga goal record! |publisher=Bundesliga |date=11 April 2026 }} A week later, on 19 April, Bayern won the [[2025–26 Bundesliga]], achieving the club's 35th league title earlier before the season's end, during the match day 30, winning 4–2 at home over [[VfB Stuttgart]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/c89558d5d5nt |title=Bayern Munich 4–2 Stuttgart |work=BBC Sport |date=19 April 2026 }}{{cite web|url=https://www.kicker.de/bayern-gegen-stuttgart-2026-bundesliga-5051012/spielbericht |title=Bayern dreht nach Rückstand auf und kürt sich vorzeitig zum Deutschen Meister |publisher=Kicker|language=de|date=19 April 2026}}{{cite news|url=https://onefootball.com/en/news/official-bayern-munich-crowned-german-champions-42736664|title=Official: Bayern Munich crowned German champions|website=OneFootball|access-date=19 April 2026}}{{cite web|url=https://www.sofascore.com/sv/football/match/vfb-stuttgart-fc-bayern-munchen/xdbsCdb#id:14065222 | title = Bayern-Stuttgart |website=Sofascore | date = 19 April 2026 | access-date = 19 April 2026}} Two days later, [[Michael Wiesinger]] was appointed as [[Sporting director|head of sport]] and [[Youth system|youth development]] at the [[FC Bayern Munich Junior Team|FC Bayern Campus]].{{cite news|url=https://fcbayern.com/en/news/2026/01/michael-wiesinger-to-be-sporting-director-at-fc-bayern-campus |title=Michael Wiesinger to be sporting director at FC Bayern Campus |publisher=FC Bayern Munich|date=31 January 2026}}{{cite news|url=https://fcbayern.com/de/news/2026/04/michael-wiesinger-uebernimmt-neue-aufgabe-am-campus |title=„Große Verantwortung“: Michael Wiesinger übernimmt neue Aufgabe am Campus |publisher=FC Bayern Munich|date=21 April 2026|language=de}} On the final matchday of the season, Bayern recorded a 5–1 victory over 1.
